title: The Thin-Lens Formula and Lens Magnification
printed_title: 77. The Thin-Lens Formula and Lens Magnification

prose.text:
The following discussion uses the thin-lens, paraxial approximation with the same homogeneous medium on both sides of the lens.
The formula relates three quantities: the distance $d$ from the object to the lens, the distance $f$ from the image to the lens, and the focal length $F$.
The lowercase letter denotes image distance, and the uppercase letter denotes focal length;

the signs of these distances will be defined below.
prose.source_text: 我们导出与三个量（物体到透镜的距离 $d$，像到透镜的距离 $f$ 及焦距 $F$）有关的公式：

prose.text:
First derive the formula using the real-image construction for a converging lens in Figure 179, with the object beyond the object-side focus.
The foci on both sides are labeled with the same letter in the figure;

each triangle below uses the focus on its own side.
This construction does not represent every signed imaging case.

Since $\triangle ABF$ and $\triangle DOF$ are similar:
$\frac{\lvert OD\rvert}{\lvert AB\rvert}=\frac{\lvert OF\rvert}{\lvert BF\rvert}$

Also, $\lvert OD\rvert=\lvert A_1B_1\rvert$, so:
$\frac{\lvert A_1B_1\rvert}{\lvert AB\rvert}=\frac{\lvert OF\rvert}{\lvert BF\rvert}=\frac{F}{d-F}$ (6.15)

In addition, $\triangle COF$ and $\triangle A_1B_1F$ are similar, giving:
$\frac{\lvert A_1B_1\rvert}{\lvert OC\rvert}=\frac{\lvert B_1F\rvert}{\lvert OF\rvert}$

Using $\lvert OC\rvert=\lvert AB\rvert$:
$\frac{\lvert A_1B_1\rvert}{\lvert AB\rvert}=\frac{f-F}{F}$ (6.16)

Equate the right-hand sides of (6.15) and (6.16):
$\frac{F}{d-F}=\frac{f-F}{F}$
Thus:
$F^2=fd-fF-Fd+F^2$

That is, $fF+Fd=fd$.
The denominators and distance products in this construction are nonzero. Dividing each term by $Ffd$ gives:
$\frac{1}{d}+\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{F}$ (6.17)

In terms of the lens's optical power, this can also be written:
$\frac{1}{d}+\frac{1}{f}=D$ (6.18)
prose.source_text: 由于 $\triangle ABF$ 和 $\triangle DOF$ 相似（见图179），得出$\frac{\lvert OD\rvert}{\lvert AB\rvert}=\frac{\lvert OF\rvert}{\lvert BF\rvert}$因为 $\lvert OD\rvert=\lvert A_1B_1\rvert$，则$\frac{\lvert A_1B_1\rvert}{\lvert AB\rvert}=\frac{\lvert OF\rvert}{\lvert BF\rvert}=\frac{F}{d-F}$　（6.15）此外，由于 $\triangle COF$ 和 $\triangle A_1B_1F$ 相似，得出：$\frac{\lvert A_1B_1\rvert}{\lvert OC\rvert}=\frac{\lvert B_1F\rvert}{\lvert OF\rvert}$考虑到 $\lvert OC\rvert=\lvert AB\rvert$，可以写出：$\frac{\lvert A_1B_1\rvert}{\lvert AB\rvert}=\frac{f-F}{F}$　（6.16）现在我们使等式（6.15）的右端和（6.16）的右端相等：$\frac{F}{d-F}=\frac{f-F}{F}$由此得$F^2=fd-fF-Fd+F^2$或者　$fF+Fd=fd$用乘积 $Ffd$ 去除上式中的各项，得到：$\frac{1}{d}+\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{F}$　（6.17）或者　$\frac{1}{d}+\frac{1}{f}=D$　（6.18）

关系式（6.17）或（6.18）叫做**薄透镜公式**. 量 $d$，$f$ 和 $F$ 可以是正值，也可以是负值. 我们不加证明地指出，在应用透镜公式时，需要根据以下规则在各项前面标上符号. 如果透镜是会聚透镜，那么它的焦点是实焦点，并且项 $\frac{1}{|F|}$ 前面的符号为“正”. 如果是发散透镜，$F<0$，并且公式（6.17）右边将是负值 $-\frac{1}{|F|}$. 如果像是实像，项 $\frac{1}{|f|}$ 的符号为“正”，如是虚像则符号为“负”. 最后，在实发光点的情况下，项 $\frac{1}{|d|}$ 前的符号为“正”，如果发光点是虚的（即射到透镜上的会聚光束延长线交于一点），则项 $\frac{1}{|d|}$ 前的符号为“负”.

prose.text:
When $F$, $f$, or $d$ is unknown, place the corresponding signed unknown in $\frac{1}{F}$, $\frac{1}{f}$, or $\frac{1}{d}$ and retain a positive sign before the term.
This notation does not prejudge the unknown as positive, and no additional guessed sign should be attached to it.
If the calculated focal length, image distance, or object distance is negative, then under the above convention it corresponds, respectively, to a virtual focus, virtual image, or virtual object point.
prose.source_text: 当 $F$，$f$ 或者 $d$ 为未知时，在相应的项 $\frac{1}{F}$、$\frac{1}{f}$ 或 $\frac{1}{d}$ 前的符号为“正”. 但如果在计算出的焦距或者透镜到像的距离或者透镜到光源的距离的结果中得出负值，那么就意味着焦点、像或者光源是虚的.
**透镜的放大率**　透镜所成的像通常与物体的大小不同.人们用**放大率**来说明物体和像大小的差异.
**像的线度与物体线度之比叫做线放大率.**

prose.text:
Return to Figure 179: object $AB$ has height $h$, and image $A_1B_1$ has height $H$.
The linear magnification is:
$\Gamma=\frac{H}{h}$

Both heights are taken as nonnegative size magnitudes, and the object height is nonzero.
prose.source_text: 为求出线放大率，我们再返回来看图 179. 如果物体 $AB$的高度为 $h$，而像 $A_1B_1$ 的高度为 $H$，那么$\Gamma=\frac{H}{h}$是线放大率.

prose.text:
Since $\triangle OAB$ and $\triangle OA_1B_1$ are similar, the ratio of corresponding side lengths gives:
$\frac{H}{h}=\frac{|f|}{|d|}$
The image and object distances are taken in absolute value because the quantity sought here is a size ratio.
prose.source_text: 由于 $\triangle OAB$ 与 $\triangle OA_1B_1$ 相似，可导出$\frac{H}{h}=\frac{|f|}{|d|}$

prose.text:
Thus, the lens's linear magnification is:
$\Gamma=\frac{|f|}{|d|}$ (6.19)
This nonnegative size ratio does not indicate image orientation;

whether the image is upright or inverted must be determined separately from a ray diagram.
